acceptance_atoms.text: Catalogue init next steps must be structured and bounded.
List-targets help must cover package and adapter routes.
Release-impact checks must classify changed surfaces without silent drops.
Manifest parsing must remain strict for generated catalogue state.

added_lines: Audience: repository maintainers reviewing a proposed documentation change.
